item.tib: byams ma rigs kyi 'jigs skyobs ma'i chog khrigs 'dod 'byung gter bum
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mkhas grub nyi ma'i dbang po mchog gis/ gdung rgyud 'gro don byon pa rnams dang dge ba'i las la brtson pa'i rgyal po sogs sbyin bdag rnams la phan pa'i rang lugs kyi byams ma rigs skyobs kyi gzhung cha lag dang bcas pa bris shig ces pa'i bka' nan ldog med gnang bzhin/ phran sku rus kyi nu bor gtogs pa'i skam rigs kyi bla ming rnam rgyal tshul khrims kyis rang lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum pa/ rab yid rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo zla dgu pa'i yar tshes bzang por bru chen gong ma'i sgrub gnas bya dur rnam thos ri khrod du bris pas bstan dang sems can la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
